name: Argon S
source:
An intergalactic spaceship is shot down in the middle of outer space. 

The ship's captain makes a fateful decision and manages to land the ship on the nearest planet: Argon S. He didn't even realize that this was the worst mistake of his life.

[From [url=https://halkind.itch.io/argon-s]Itch.io[/url]]
